svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Quill: cut 240 from 22.0 x 2.0 chromoly tube. Weld a 3 mm steel cap

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: in the top with an 8.5 hole; fit the bought expander wedge at the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: bottom with the M8 x 260 expander bolt (13 mm head on the cap).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Head plate: 127 x 44 x 10, 4130. Cope one end to the quill's 22 curve.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill 6.8 and tap M8, eight holes: at 27, 63, 87 and 123 ahead of

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the quill's center line, 13 each side of the plate's center line.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Weld the plate square across the quill's front, its top flush with

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the quill top and level when the quill leans back 20 deg (use a

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 70 deg jig block). TIG both sides.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Scribe the minimum insertion mark 100 up from the quill's bottom.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the quill slides in the 22.2 bore of the steerer; the plate

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: clears the headset locknut by 2 mm at the lowest setting.
